newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firm wins bidding for PNOC unit.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firm wins bidding for PNOC unit.

text.p: The Philippine National Oil Co (PNOC) said on Wednesday that local firm Herma Shipping and Transport Corp beat out four other firms to win the bid for a 40 percent stake of PNOC unit PNOC Shipping and Transport Corp.
PNOC said in a statement that Herma's bid of 301.23 million pesos was 88.23 million pesos higher than the indicative price set by PNOC of 213 million pesos.

"We are happy about the results of the bidding in consonance with the government's mandate to privatise PSTC. We hope the joint venture will continue servicing the shipping needs of our domestic oil industry," PSTC president Nemesio Prudente said in the statement.
PNOC will own the remaining 60 percent of the shipping firm.
PNOC said PT Berlian Laju Tankers of Indonesia submitted the second highest bid of 266.25 million pesos. Three out of the four other bidders were foreign firms.
